name: firmware-reverify-weekly
prompt: Re-run the firmware design verification for the checked-in contract. Run `/firmware:gates` on the workspace contract (or `python3 $FIRMWARE_PLUGIN/scripts/firmware_launcher.py gates <contract>`), compare the verdicts to the recorded ones in the design report, and write a short result to records/. If any gate regressed from pass to fail or unknown, say so explicitly in the run summary.
